[[File:PC logo horizontal lockup 2026.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Players Committee logo<ref name="logo">Header logo of [https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ starwarsccg.org], shown on every page including About Us (''logo.jpg'': [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/logo.jpg live file], [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125011445/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/logo.jpg Wayback capture of 25 January 2021]; page: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250316172158/https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ Wayback, 16 March 2025]). Checked on the live site on 10 October 2026.</ref>]]
The '''Players Committee''' (PC) is the volunteer organization that has run the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game since [[Decipher]] stopped producing it. It maintains the rules, creates and updates virtual cards, organizes tournaments and championships, and promotes the game. It is led by the [[Players Committee advocates|Advocate Council]] and is incorporated as a 501(c)(3) charitable organization.<ref name="about">[https://playerscommittee.org/about/ About the Players Committee], playerscommittee.org</ref>

== Mission ==

The PC states its goal as continuing the history, passion and friendly nature of the game, and manages it to prioritize gameplay over collectibility. Its virtual cards are distributed free of charge.<ref name="about" /> Its work is divided among teams that report to the advocates:<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf]</ref>

* '''Rules:''' rulings, errata, and the [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook|Advanced Rulebook]].
* '''Design and development:''' new virtual cards, playtesting, proofing and graphics.
* '''Tournaments:''' local, regional and world championships, and alternative formats.
* '''Marketing and communications:''' outreach, social media, prize support, news and player surveys.
* '''Technology:''' the [[GEMP]] online platform and the website.

== Organization ==

{{Hatnote|Main article: [[Players Committee organization]]}}

The PC's organization chart shows a Lead Advocate and six advocates (rules, marketing, design, production, tournaments and communications), each supported by volunteer teams such as prize support, streaming, design and development, proofing, playtesting, graphics and the tournament committee. A GEMP technology team, a legal role and a store manager are shown alongside.<ref name="oc2024" />

== Background ==

In December 2001 Decipher announced that it could not extend its Lucasfilm license, and it created a volunteer committee to carry the game forward.<ref name="about" /> The first six Player Advocates were named on 25 January 2002.<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter dated 25 January 2002)</ref> Cards could be distributed only electronically and for free, which led to the virtual card program (see [[V-slips]] and [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]). The PC moved to its current site, starwarsccg.org, in June 2009,<ref name="domain2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102740/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=69 New Domain and Server], starwarsccg.org (posted 10 June 2009; Wayback, 6 July 2009)</ref> and reset the competitive virtual card pool in 2014 (see [[Formats]]). More detail is on [[History of the Players Committee]].

== Logo history ==

The current logo, shown at the top of this page, is the horizontal lockup of the STAR WARS Customizable Card Game box mark and the words PLAYERS COMMITTEE. It has been the header logo of starwarsccg.org since 2013.<ref name="logo-lockup">[http://starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], [https://web.archive.org/web/20131214011308/http://starwarsccg.org/ Wayback capture of 14 December 2013] (first capture with the lockup in the header); current header logo on the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ About Us] page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250316172158/https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ Wayback, 16 March 2025]).</ref> The box mark is also used on its own, in white on black or black on white, as the avatar of the committee's GitHub organizations.<ref name="logo-github">GitHub organization avatars: [https://github.com/PlayersCommittee PlayersCommittee] (white on black; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195545/https://github.com/PlayersCommittee Wayback, 8 October 2026]) and [https://github.com/swccgpc swccgpc] (black on white, [https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/25210454?v=4 u/25210454]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20250823180219/https://github.com/swccgpc Wayback, 23 August 2025]).</ref> The nonprofit site playerscommittee.org uses a separate SWCCG / PLAYERS COMMITTEE mark.<ref name="logo-nonprofit">[https://playerscommittee.org/ playerscommittee.org] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20250714230849/http://playerscommittee.org/ Wayback, 14 July 2025]).</ref>
